transport: Apollo Automatic Persisted Query (APQ) — GET with operationName/variables/extensions.persistedQuery.sha256Hash, no query body needed
note: Reproduced successfully via plain curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome, Referer=https://linkareer.com/) with no browser/Playwright required. Confirmed on 2026-08-06.

CalendarScreen_ActivityCalendarEntries.purpose: Returns actual posting entries (id, title, org, dates) for a date range. This is the primary listing source.
confirmed_findings: activityTypeIDs=['1'] corresponds to the 'activity' tab (contest/extracurricular/etc); recruitDiscovery URL uses activityType=recruit — separate activityTypeID value TBD, needs a second sniff pass

status='OPEN' does NOT restrict to currently-open recruitment — verified 2020-03 range still returns postings whose recruitCloseAt is long past (e.g. recruitCloseAt=1584284399000 for a query issued in 2026). Historical/closed postings ARE retrievable through this endpoint.
Omitting 'status' from filterBy produced an identical response to status='OPEN' in the one test run — needs more samples before concluding it's a no-op filter.

response ids for 2020-03 range were in the ~34000-35000 range vs ~339000 range for 2026-08, consistent with roughly-monotonic sequential id growth (PROMPT 0 C.7 candidate answer: likely yes, needs the full 30+ sample anchor set to confirm).
